question: Where can I find restaurant that lies within 170 kilometers en route to Charlottesville and Albemarle County Courthouse Historic District, Charlottesville, VA from Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo, Edinburg, VA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Edinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Albemarle County Courthouse Historic District%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Charlottesville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(r.geom::geography, 170000)::geometry AS geom -- 170 kilometers = 170,000 meters FROM route_line r ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_route)::geography);
